# GTMObserver
> The Edge-Native Google Tag Manager Automation & Autonomous GA4 Telemetry Platform.

GTMObserver (https://gtmobserver.com) is a multi-tenant analytics automation SaaS built natively on Cloudflare Workers and D1 edge architecture. It serves digital agencies, hospitality portfolios, e-commerce brands, and solo practitioners across **Personal Workspaces** and **Organizations**:

1. **Multi-Tenant Organizations, Personal Workspaces & Universal Sharing**: Organize 50+ client websites into Organizations or Personal Workspaces with Clerk authentication, manage team roles, share per-project access (`viewer`, `editor`, `admin`) with anyone by email, and safely retire projects to Trash (automatically closing all attached GA4 monitors).
2. **Automated Google Tag Manager (GTM) Deployment & Audits**: 1-click deployment of pre-validated tracking recipes directly into Google Tag Manager workspaces via the GTM API v2, paired with GTM health audits and downloadable A4 PDF reports.
3. **Autonomous GA4 Telemetry Observer & 22-Point Audits**: Background edge monitoring running every 15 minutes (`*/15 * * * *`) with custom IANA timezones, evaluating 14 GA4 metrics across 11 comparison windows and 20 templates, alongside a 22-point GA4 Property Audit with executive A4 PDF exports.

## Core Capabilities
- **Workspaces, Onboarding & Polar.sh Billing**:
  - Direct sign-up into your workspace with in-dashboard Organization switcher and creation (`/organization`, `/organizations/:orgId`, `/access`, `/settings`).
  - Guided 4-step Project Onboarding linking Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager containers/workspaces, and starter GA4 Observer monitors.
  - Polar.sh subscription sync and one-click Customer Portal for invoices and workspace capacity management.
  - Safe Trash workflow with immediate monitor closure, Restore, Permanent Delete, and Empty Trash.
- **Automated GTM Recipe Library & Health Audits**:
  - Basic Outbound Clicks (`tel:`, `mailto:`, Google Maps, Apple Maps/Waze, TripAdvisor, Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, generic external links).
  - Engagement & Social Tracking (Scroll Depth 25/50/75/90%, YouTube/Vimeo Video, Universal Social clicks).
  - WordPress, CRM & Hospitality Forms (Elementor, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, HubSpot, Salesforce, Revinate, Zmail Direct, Generic HTML, custom PHP `sendmail.php`).
  - Hotel & Hospitality Booking Engines (StayNTouch, Synxis/SBE, Windsurfer, Mews, iHotelier, Safara).
  - WooCommerce Standard GA4 E-Commerce (`view_item`, `add_to_cart`, checkout funnel, `purchase`).
  - GTM Health Audits detecting duplicate tags, shared triggers, and orphaned triggers/variables with server-rendered A4 PDF exports.
- **GA4 Real-Time Anomaly Detection & 22-Point Audits**:
  - Evaluates 14 metrics (`sessions`, `activeUsers`, `totalUsers`, `newUsers`, `engagementRate`, `bounceRate`, `averageSessionDuration`, `keyEvents`, `transactions`, `totalRevenue`, `ecommercePurchases`, `sessionKeyEventRate`, `screenPageViews`, `eventCount`).
  - Dimensional segmentation by Channel/Source, Medium, and Device Category across 11 comparison windows (`Yesterday vs Last Week`, `Day over Day`, `WoW`, `MoM`, `28-Day`, `YoY`).
  - Compound `Match ANY` / `Match ALL` logic with Cloudflare Cron sweeps every 15 minutes (`*/15 * * * *`).
  - Authenticated Resend HTML + PDF email alerts with separate Automated Issue and Manual Report histories.
  - 22-Point GA4 Property Audit covering cross-domain/referrals, 9 integrations (GSC, Google Ads, BigQuery, Signals, Enhanced Measurement, DV360, SA360, AdSense, MP Secrets), data retention/attribution, PII URL checks, and Key Events with branded A4 PDF export.
